Whichever lands second merges `main` and re-measures `check:pm-skill-ratchet`. Re-check the open-PR list for `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` before your first push and name what you found.

Ruling: batch #3 items 1.1 / 1.2 / 2 · letters A / A / A · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-23T02:37:14Z

Recorded by the director ruling thread 「待决策汇总」 (Claude Code project "Objectstack", account `os-elon-musk`). Batch doc: https://claude.ai/artifact/RfQPT58DF4ZjmErk8PZmJi. The maintainer's one word covers all three recommendations named in the batch's 回批 line (「1.1 A 1.2 A 2A」或「同意」). The ruling thread only records; the card thread and the owning seat execute.

**Item 1.1 — A (keep).** `references/dispatch-runbook.md` L115 (a dev resolves its own implementation choices and records them in `open_questions`) and `SKILL.md` L216–L218 (the named non-escalation classes) stay, plus one guard sentence: an implementation choice may not change product-visible behaviour or a contract; if it would, the dev stops and reports a `needs_decision` fork (the existing triage-duties clause 「实施中发现契约终究要动 ⇒ dev 停手」 remains the backstop). Workload: 1 line, in the F1 fix push of PR #25348.

**Item 1.2 — A (keep as an emergency valve).** triage-duties 例外二 (two reds within an hour on a gate the PR did not touch → any seat may flip it to report-only, ruling follows) stays, with three hard conditions: (a) report-only only — never delete the gate or skip a test; (b) at the moment of the flip, the item goes to 「待决策汇总」 for the next ruling batch with both red run links; (c) if the maintainer disagrees, the flip is reverted. Workload: 2 lines, same push.

**Item 2 — A (restore and extend the human-ruling floor).** The F1 fix restores the `origin/main` 54df640b L95–L97 list (功能新增；ADR；协议/公开契约变化；破坏性或难回滚动作；安全/权限边界；门禁削弱；新增运行时第三方依赖；花费/配额/舰队形态/默认模型档位；新增必须门禁/hook/棘轮) and extends it, and `SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉 gains the maintainer's two tests (02:22 「有风险的事情让我决裁；可能大幅增加开发量的事情要我决裁」) as written in the batch doc, card 2 ②–④:

- **Risk, any one ⇒ to the maintainer:** security / permission / identity / tenancy boundary (incl. default permission sets, OWD, external or guest populations, delegated admin); irreversible data (migration, delete, column shape, meaning of existing rows); public-contract or accept-set change (Clause-② yes), protocol key added or retired, ADR added or changed; externally visible action (release, npm publish, release notes, promises in public docs, outside communication); gate weakening or any waiver / exception (threshold, mandatory check, ceiling, skipped test, pin waiver, accepted-for-GA); contradicts a prior ruling or standing order, or sets a new standing order; silent failure (no gate or test would catch a wrong choice).
- **Workload, any one ⇒ to the maintainer:** any option ≥ one size/l PR or spanning ≥ 2 packages; the chosen option ≥ 2× the cheapest viable one; a new permanent maintenance surface (protocol key, metadata type, mandatory gate, runtime dependency, new service, new lane); ≥ 3 serial cards or > 1 workday of a concurrency slot.
- **Extra floor classes:** release and publication (GA / cut, pin waiver, 摘牌 or explicit accept, major bump, known-issues notes, npm / site publish); card fate (close as not planned, p1 / p2 downgrade, withdraw a dispatched card, cut scope); rules and process (skills, AGENTS / CLAUDE, workflows, CODEOWNERS, ratchet-ceiling raise, standing orders, exceptions); defaults and factory shape (new-tenant defaults, isDefault permission sets, default OWD, default model tier, default concurrency); resources and spend; external promises; cross-lane conflicts (two p1s on one file surface or one slot, lane ownership, seat replacement); identity and tenancy model.
- **Explicitly not escalated** (all four hold: no product-visible behaviour change, no contract change, reversible, gate-backed): implementation detail; the named non-escalation classes; the four bookkeeping classes; p3 order and dispatch order; CI reruns; merged-branch cleanup; patch-level dependency bumps under lockfile + CI; mechanical steps under an existing ruling (e.g. `ruledRaises`).

Workload: ≈ 15 lines across `references/triage-duties.md` (人工地板 section) and `SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉, ratchet rows counted on landing; same PR, same F1 fix push. From now on every card presented to the maintainer names which test it hits.

**Execution:** the card thread 技能撤销自主裁决 folds all three items into PR #25348's F1 fix push; `domain:skills` seat 2 re-reviews the new head at CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER; landing still waits on the maintainer's own 「可以落地」 (Tier S). The Skills seat's 01:43 decision card on item 1.1 is superseded by this ruling.
